purpose: Prevent misinterpretation of prescribed-Ca amplitude, record mechanistic Ca-to-stress timing, and preserve source-stress fields needed for Level 3 transfer checks.

calciumAmplitudeClarification.rule: targetPeakAmplitudeUM is an amplitude above diastolic Ca, not the absolute Ca target. Absolute peak target is diastolicCaUM + targetPeakAmplitudeUM unless the target pack explicitly defines otherwise.
calciumAmplitudeClarification.antiMisread: Do not label a measured peak near 1.016 uM as a 13% overshoot when the configured absolute target is approximately 1.02 uM.

knownEncouragingPhase2BReference.notes: These values are recorded as review context for Level 3 entry gating; they are not a replacement for target-pack acceptance.
